tools.name: get_transcript
tools.description: Spoken-word transcript of a public video, with timestamped segments where the source publishes them. Instagram only. Credits: 1 per call plus 20 per started minute of video. Input: url.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: Short LLM summary of what a public video actually says, built on its transcript. Instagram only. Credits: 4 per call plus 20 per started minute of video. Input: url.

tools.name: get_post_stats
tools.description: Engagement stats for one public post or video: views, likes, comments, shares and reposts where the platform publishes them. Instagram only. Credits: 1 per call. Input: url.

tools.name: get_comments
tools.description: Comments on a public post or video, newest first, paginated with limit and cursor. Instagram only. Credits: 1 per item returned, and an empty result is free (25 a day per account, then 1 credit each). Input: url.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Profile, page or channel record for a public account: follower and subscriber counts, bio, and totals. Instagram only. Credits: 1 per call. Input: handle.

tools.name: get_channel_posts
tools.description: Recent public posts or videos from one account, with per-item metrics. Instagram only. Credits: 1 per item returned, and an empty result is free (25 a day per account, then 1 credit each). Input: handle.

tools.name: search_hashtag
tools.description: Public posts carrying a hashtag. Instagram only. Credits: 1 per item returned, and an empty result is free (25 a day per account, then 1 credit each). Input: query.

tools.name: download_media
tools.description: Direct media URLs for a public post or video, served from the platform's own CDN. Instagram only. Credits: 8 per call. Input: url.

tools.name: list_endpoints
tools.description: Discover every Instagram endpoint that can serve right now, with its path, what it takes as input, what one credit buys, and whether it paginates. Free — this reads our registry and calls nothing upstream. Use it to find the endpoint for anything the other tools do not cover, then call it with call_

tools.name: call_endpoint
tools.description: Call any Instagram endpoint from list_endpoints by its path under /v1/instagram/. This reaches everything Instagram offers, including what the capability tools above do not wrap; a path on another platform is refused. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.instadata.dev" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_transcript, get_summary, get_post_stats, get_comments, get_channel_posts, search_hashtag · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: get_post_stats, get_comments, download_media.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_transcript, get_summary, get_post_stats, get_comments, get_channel_posts, search_hashtag · Private data: get_profile · Public sink: get_post_stats, get_comments, download_media

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
